title: Literal open restriction gives a K-flat derived pullback representative
statement: For every scheme X, open U, scheme T and morphism q:T→U, with the specified scheme derived categories, and every K-flat complex P on X with eP:DQ(P)≅K, the literal restriction Q of P to U is K-flat, the specified derived pullback counit for q at Q is invertible, and DQ(Q)≅L(U.ι)*(K). No cartesian square or stalk point is needed.

source.place: K-flat stalk criterion; Tag 0D5U, exact open restriction; the universal derived counit and the pinned tensor-pullback adjunction identify the literal restriction.

proof.text: Open restriction preserves K-flatness by the stalk criterion.
Apply the already proved counit_isIso_kFlat theorem from IsomorphismPullbackCounit to the literal restricted K-flat complex; apply it again along U.ι to the original complex.

Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensor pullback along U.ι with literal restriction. Map this natural isomorphism to complexes and localization, then use the inverse specified counit along U.ι and the quotientCompQhIso factors. Compose with derived pullback of eP.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_restricted_representative_data
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) (q : T ⟶ U.toScheme)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K) :
    let Q : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ :=
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    ∃ (_hQ : Q.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
      (_hcQ : IsIso ((counit q).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q)))
      (_eQ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ≅ (derivedPullback U.ι).obj K), True
